selection_process: Test Medium No. of Questions Maximum Marks Time Allotted
Selection for CRP CSA-XVI is a two-tier process consisting of an Online Preliminary Examination and an Online Main Examination
followed by a qualifying Local Language Proficiency Test before joining.

There is a penalty of one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in both the Preliminary and Main Examinations. No penalty applies to unattempted questions. Candidates must clear individual cut-offs in each test as well as an overall cut-off. Only marks obtained in the Main Examination are considered for the final merit list; Preliminary Exam marks are used only for shortlisting.

Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the State/UT they apply for. Candidates who have studied that language up to Class 10 or above are exempt from a separate test. Others must clear a qualifying (marks-based) Local Language Proficiency Test conducted after the Main Exam/provisional allotment but before joining - failing this test means disqualification from the process.

Shortlisted candidates are provisionally allotted to one of the participating banks based on merit-cum-preference and State/UT-wise vacancies reported to IBPS. A reserve list of approximately 30% of vacancies in each category may also be maintained
though this does not guarantee eventual allotment. Provisional allotment is subject to identity verification and the candidate being found medically fit and otherwise eligible by the allotted bank.
how_to_apply: Candidates can apply online only - no other mode of application is accepted.
Visit the official IBPS website www.ibps.in and open the "CRP CSA" link, then click "Click Here to Apply Online for CRP – Customer Service Associates (CRP-CSA-XVI)".
Click "Click Here for New Registration" and enter basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password (also sent by email/SMS).

Upload the required scanned documents: photograph, signature, left thumb impression, a handwritten declaration, SSC/SSLC/10th standard or equivalent certificate, and the certificate mentioned in Clause K(ix) if applicable - as per the specifications in Annexure IV of the notification.
Carefully fill in all sections of the online application form using the "Save and Next" facility to verify details before final submission, since most fields cannot be edited after submission.
Indicate the State/UT for which you want to be considered for provisional allotment - this choice is irrevocable once submitted.
Pay the application fee/intimation charges online through the integrated payment gateway (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/IMPS/Wallets/UPI).
On successful payment, take a printout of the e-receipt and the completed application form for your records.
important_instructions: Fields such as Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, State/UT (vacancy, correspondence and permanent address), Post, and Nationality cannot be edited after submission. A 2-day Edit Window is provided after the registration closing date to correct other details, for a fee of ₹200; dates for this window will be announced separately on the official website. Not more than one application is allowed per candidate; in case of multiple applications, only the latest completed one is considered valid. Any resulting dispute is subject to the sole jurisdiction of courts situated at Mumbai. Candidates are advised to apply well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Candidates who have completed their graduation can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and Bank Jobs 2026. Those preparing for banking exams may also check IBPS PO Recruitment 2026 and other All India Government Jobs for more opportunities.

content_sections.heading: IBPS Clerk Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: IBPS has indicated state-wise and category-wise vacancies for the Customer Service Associate post across 11 participating banks in Annexure-I of the notification. The vacancies are described as indicative and anticipated, and the final numbers depend on actual requirements reported by the participating banks closer to the provisional allotment stage. Union Bank of India's vacancies are marked "NR" (Not Reported) in every state/UT, so the totals below understate the true final vacancy count. Note on totals: the notification gives a state-wise total for each State/UT (as shown below) but does not state one all-India grand total. Adding up all the state totals gives approximately 11,403 posts - this is a figure computed by summing the notification's own tables, not a number stated directly in the notification, and it excludes any vacancies from Union Bank of India since those are marked "Not Reported." The full category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR) and bank-wise vacancy breakup for each State/UT, along with reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (HI/OC/VI/ID) and Ex-Servicemen, is given in Annexure-I of the official notification. Candidates provisionally allotted through CRP CSA-XVI can be posted to any one of the following 11 banks, based on merit-cum-preference: IBPS PO Recruitment 2026 | IBPS SO Recruitment 2026 | SBI Clerk Recruitment 2026

content_sections.heading: IBPS Clerk Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The eligibility conditions below are the basic criteria for applying. IBPS clarifies that qualifying in the CRP and being provisionally allotted to a bank does not guarantee employment - the concerned bank retains the final say on appointment. Ex-Servicemen who do not hold the above civil qualification are eligible if they are matriculate Ex-Servicemen who obtained the Army Special Certificate of Education (or the equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate) after completing at least 15 years of service in the Armed Forces, with the certificate dated on or before 21.08.2026.

rows.details: Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962, or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India
Minimum 20 years, Maximum 28 years (born not earlier than 02.08.1998 and not later than 01.08.2006)
A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognised by the Government of India, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government
Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the specified/opted local language of the State/UT they apply for (see Local Language Proficiency Test section)
Mandatory - a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in computer operations, or having studied Computer/IT as a subject in High School/College

content_sections.heading: IBPS Clerk Age Limit
content_sections.text: The standard age limit is 20 to 28 years as on 01.08.2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to reserved categories as follows: Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is available cumulatively with only one of the other relaxation categories listed above (Point II 3 to 5 of the notification), not with more than one.

rows.age_relaxation: Actual period of service in defence forces + 3 years (8 years for Disabled Ex-Servicemen belonging to SC/ST), subject to a maximum age of 50 years

rows.category: Widows, divorced women, and women legally separated (not remarried)
rows.age_relaxation: Age concession up to 35 years for General/EWS, 38 years for OBC, 40 years for SC/ST

faq.question: Q1. What is IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the CRP CSA-XVI notification released by IBPS for recruiting Customer Service Associates (Clerks) in 11 participating Public Sector Banks, for vacancies of the financial year 2027-28.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification gives indicative, state-wise vacancies for each participating bank in Annexure-I; a national grand total is not stated directly, though summing the state totals gives approximately 11,403 posts (excluding Union Bank of India, whose vacancies are marked "Not Reported").

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 21.08.2026, the same date by which the application fee must also be paid.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A graduation degree in any discipline from a university recognised by the Government of India, along with mandatory computer literacy and proficiency in the local language of the applied State/UT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 01.08.2026, with age relaxation available for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, and certain categories of women as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM candidates and ₹850 for all other candidates, payable online.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only through the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in, under the CRP CSA section - no offline or other mode is accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: An Online Preliminary Examination, followed by an Online Main Examination, and a qualifying Local Language Proficiency Test before joining the allotted bank.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for IBPS Clerk (Customer Service Associate)?
faq.answer: The basic pay scale is ₹24050-1340/3-28070-1650/3-33020-2000/4-41020-2340/7-57400-4400/1-61800-2680/1-64480, plus allowances and perquisites as per the allotted participating bank's rules.

faq.question: Q10. Which banks are participating in IBPS CRP CSA-XVI?
faq.answer: Bank of Baroda, Bank of India, Bank of Maharashtra, Canara Bank, Central Bank of India, Indian Bank, Indian Overseas Bank, Punjab National Bank, Punjab & Sind Bank, UCO Bank, and Union Bank of India.
